_comment: Authoring config for canary-local/tools/gen_boards.py. Each entry turns a vendor STEP (boards/vendor/*.step) into a committed, colour-baked GLB (canary-local/boards/<id>.glb) plus a row in canary-local/devices/boards.json. Geometry facts in boards.json are recomputed from the committed GLB by the same loader the browser uses (tools/glb_facts.mjs), so the JSON can never lie about the mesh. Pinouts are the Canary-relevant pins (from firmware/configs + docs/hardware/bom_*.csv), not the full generic map.

boards.name: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense
boards.provenance: Seeed Studio open-hardware CAD (STEP). Redistributed here as the board's source of truth for the local viewer; see boards/vendor/README.md. Verify Seeed's licence terms before external redistribution.
boards.blurb: 21 x 17.8 mm. ESP32-S3, 8 MB flash / 8 MB PSRAM, onboard LiPo charger; the Sense expansion adds the OV camera + PDM mic on a stacked B2B board. The WAP build uses the plain-facing pins for chirp, tamper, LED and GNSS.

pinout.label: Status RGB LED
pinout.use: External WS2812 — pin defined but not driven by canary-wap firmware yet; the live indicator is the onboard LED (GPIO21).

pinout.label: Tamper
pinout.use: Reed / hall switch (INPUT_PULLUP, active-low) — FEATURE_TAMPER_GPIO defined but not yet consumed by canary-wap firmware.

pinout.label: Battery
pinout.use: JST-PH LiPo, charged by the onboard charger

boards.name: Seeed Grove Vision AI V2
boards.provenance: Seeed Studio CAD (STEP) supplied with a printable stand + camera shroud + adapter. The generator drops those mount parts by name (mounting_plate, camera_mounting_shroud, adapter) and keeps only the board + camera. Verify Seeed's licence terms before external redistribution.
boards.blurb: Himax WiseEye2 HX6538 (Arm Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U55 NPU). Talks to the host over I2C on the Grove connector; the OV camera rides on the CSI FPC. Mount parts from the source assembly are filtered out.

pinout.label: Grove I2C
pinout.use: Sensor bus to the host — the GPIOs depend on the host board: DevKit-C3 4/5, XIAO-C3 6/7 (D4/D5), XIAO-S3 5/6 (D4/D5).

boards.name: Seeed Round Display for XIAO
boards.provenance: Seeed Studio CAD (SolidWorks STEP export). This export did not carry per-solid colours through the tessellator, so materials are assigned by geometry (dark PCB + grey glass); the shape is the vendor's exact model. Verify Seeed's licence terms before external redistribution.
boards.blurb: Ø 39 mm 1.28-in GC9A01 (240x240) with CST816S touch, PCF8563 RTC, microSD and a LiPo charger; it seats a XIAO on its back socket. The backlight on D6/GPIO43 is PWM-dimmable — that is the bedside night floor.
